note: The seven MVP Feng Shui rules (PRD §4.3). Numbers, lists and copy are yours to change; see docs/rule-authoring.md for what needs a developer and what does not. Every 'explanation' and 'fix' below is a developer-written draft awaiting review — that is what draft:true means.

rules.title: Where you can see the door
rules.explanation: The commanding position lets you see the door without sitting in its direct path, so nothing arrives unannounced.
rules.fix: Move it so the door is visible on a diagonal, clear of the door's straight line.

rules.title: Bed facing the door
rules.explanation: A bed whose foot points straight out the door echoes how the dead are carried out, and rest suffers for it.
rules.fix: Shift the bed off the door's line, or turn it so the foot no longer aims at the doorway.

rules.title: Mirror facing the bed
rules.explanation: A mirror facing the bed is said to disturb sleep by reflecting and doubling the activity of the room.
rules.fix: Turn the mirror away from the bed, move it to another wall, or cover it at night.

rules.title: Room to move
rules.explanation: People and energy both need room to move; a blocked entry or a pinched walkway makes a room feel stuck.
rules.fix: Clear the path in from the door and leave at least 60 cm between pieces you walk between.

rules.title: A clear entrance
rules.explanation: The entrance is where energy enters a room, and anything in the door's swing or just inside it narrows that flow.
rules.fix: Move the item clear of the door's swing and leave the space just inside the doorway open.

rules.title: Support behind you
rules.explanation: Sitting with your back to the door means you cannot see who approaches, which quietly undermines focus and ease.
rules.fix: Turn the seat so the door is in view, or place a solid wall or high back behind it.

rules.title: Fits the room
rules.explanation: One piece dominating the floor crowds a room and leaves the other elements no space to balance it.
rules.fix: Swap in a smaller piece, or move this one to a room it does not dominate.
